description.trigger: Use the Pipedrive Events Trigger activity to initiate workflows based on key CRM events such as deals being created or updated, activities completed, leads added, or contacts modified allowing you to automate actions instantly when changes occur in Pipedrive.
description.integration: Pipedrive is a leading CRM platform that helps sales teams manage pipelines, track deals, and close more sales. This integration connects Pipedrive with Boltic to automate workflows and sync data across platforms.
